method: Inspected twelve evenly spaced native frames in each of the front, rear and side views, with full frame-count, source-hash, contact and trace checks.
observations: The film begins on its liner, separate from the plate.
Stock YAM fingers visibly lift and place the loose film; there are no finger extensions or attached tongs.
The robot picks up the loose roller and presses successive lanes over the plate.
The final film covers the well array; the roller is released and both hands are clear.
No team identifiers or visible teleportation in the inspected frames.
limitations: The wrist briefly occludes parts of placement and rolling in the front view; the side view is frequently occluded. The rear view confirms placement and final coverage. Inspection was sampled, not a claim of watching every frame.
